title: muser runtime snapshot extensions consumed by muser-console
description: Console-owned companion to the verbatim imported metrics-schema.json. It contracts fields emitted by muser@753c2a5 that intentionally remain outside that strict published schema. A live snapshot must satisfy this schema and, after removing only these named extensions, the imported schema.

active_drain_gbps.description: Measured installed payload bits divided by the receiver's active post-first-byte segment-drain span. This is not the end-to-end transfer throughput field.

_active_drain_ns.description: Measured receiver active post-first-byte segment-drain span in nanoseconds; backing duration for active_drain_gbps.

dflash_drafted_tokens.description: Process-monotonic measured draft tokens verified against the target.

dflash_accepted_tokens.description: Process-monotonic measured tokens accepted from the draft.

dflash_disabled.description: Process-monotonic count of requests that finished with DFlash speculation disabled.

dflash_disabled_at_tokens.description: Process-monotonic sum of committed-token positions at gate closures.

dflash_disable_events.description: Process-monotonic measured gate-closure events, including close/reopen cycles.

draft_sink_size.description: Last-value effective draft sink geometry of the most recent DFlash request.

draft_sliding_window.description: Last-value effective draft sliding-window geometry of the most recent DFlash request.
